**Requested Game or Feature:**
(e.g., Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, Quake 3 Arena, Cloud Sync API)

**Game Engine / Technical Background:**
Is there an existing open-source WebAssembly/Emscripten engine port (e.g., Emscripten, JS-DOS, WebQuake, Xash3D, EmulatorJS)? Provide links if known.

**Why would this be a great addition to Lumeza Cyber-Arcade?**
Explain gameplay value, nostalgia, performance characteristics, and controls suitability for browser gaming.

**Asset Requirements:**
Does the game use free/open-source shareware assets, or does it require user-provided assets?
